family: Trojanised signed developer tool (cloud credential theft)
notes: Fake/trojanised Kubernetes dashboard installed under Program Files (admin installer, valid certificate) reads kubeconfig, Docker, AWS and Azure CLI credentials and posts them to a raw IP. All reads qualify for dev_tool_reader, so ST-01 is Low Audit and ST-04 is Audit-only (High) with no kill or block.
known_gap: dev_tool_reader: any validly signed Program Files non-interpreter reading kubeconfig / Docker / AWS / Azure is Low Audit, and the reader sending itself counts as a vendor send (Low)
